header.title: ASML's hybrid bonding tool threatens Besi's logic and HBM equipment franchise

s01_bottom_line.text: ASML is building a die-to-wafer hybrid bonding tool, evidenced by 27 bonding patent families filed Dec 2022-Nov 2024 and a report it began architecture design with Prodrive and VDL ETG; Besi is today the only supplier with D2W tools in volume production, with most of its HB business in logic at TSMC and Intel.

SemiAnalysis frames ASML's entry as 'bad news for Besi,' expecting advanced logic to adopt ASML's tool first and Besi's HBM prospects to weaken from Korean competition and delayed HBM adoption. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩

If ASML wins advanced-logic HB customers first using its lithography-derived alignment and particle-control strengths, Besi could lose its leadership in the fastest-growing HB segment; but the article does not quantify revenue or earnings impact for either company.

items.text: ASML filed 27 bonding patent families between December 2022 and November 2024, most of them die-to-wafer.
The Elec reported in March that ASML had started architecture design of a hybrid bonder with Prodrive Technologies and VDL ETG.
ASML's NXT:2100i holds 0.9nm overlay on a single machine.
ASML metrology plus scanner correction brings post-bond overlay from 40-60nm down to below 4nm.
ASML announced joint initiatives with TSMC, Intel Foundry and Samsung to move photomasks from 6-inch to 12-inch for High NA EUV
